name: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619)
description: PHP2Shell exploitation, Oct-Nov 2026, mapped to ATT&CK Enterprise v20.1. Red = observed, orange = reported or partial, yellow = expected follow-on activity to hunt for.

techniques.comment: Scanners probing for vulnerable PHP before and after disclosure (Wiz, Amazon).
Unauthenticated RCE in the PHP engine; CISA KEV 26 Oct 2026; honeypot exploitation confirmed.
Partial: stalled uploads used to occupy PHP workers as a step in the exploit chain, not as the goal.
Reported: the memory-disclosure path can leak secrets from other requests without code execution (Wiz).
PAN-OS campaign: PHP2Shell chained with a Linux kernel flaw for root (Dream Research, verified by Unit 42).
Expected: commands run as the web user after RCE; hunt for shells spawned by PHP workers.
Expected: session-poisoning tooling plants PHP code; hunt for web shells.
Expected: download tools (curl, wget) started by PHP workers.
